2608.03892.title: Intertemporal Preference Steering in Qwen3 via Contrastive Activation Addition
2608.03892.paper_summary: We study linear representations of temporal horizon in the large language model Qwen3-32B and use them to change the model's time-related preferences, recommendations, and capabilities. We train contrastive linear probes on teacher-forced temporal-choice answers to find a short-term versus long-term direction in the model's residual stream, and evaluate contrastive activation-addition steering on a held-out binary temporal-choice task, an out-of-distribution monetary intertemporal-choice task, and a TravelPlanner capability benchmark. The central result is that temporal-horizon directions can be identified with simple contrastive linear probes and then used for steering to induce large, bidirectional preference changes. On an out-of-distribution monetary choice task that varies reward size and delay, steering strongly shifts the model's indifference threshold between smaller-sooner and larger-later rewards in both directions. We further show improvements on a planning-related capability metric under moderate temporal steering. These results suggest that model intertemporal preferences are measurable and steerable, which is relevant for AI systems that give advice involving delayed costs and benefits, and for safety questions about long-horizon planning.
2608.03892.paper_summary_zh: 我們研究大型語言模型 Qwen3-32B 中的時間視野線性表示，並利用它們來改變模型的時間相關偏好、建議和能力。 我們在教師強制的時間選擇答案上訓練對比線性探針，以找出模型的殘差流中的短期與長期方向，並在保留的二元時間選擇任務、分佈外的貨幣跨期選擇任務以及 TravelPlanner 能力基準上評估對比激活添加引導。 主要結果是，可以通過簡單的對比線性探針識別時間視野方向，然後用於引導以誘導大型的雙向偏好變化。 在一個變化獎勵大小和延遲的分佈外貨幣選擇任務中，引導強烈改變模型在較小較快和較大較晚獎勵之間的無差異閾值，並且是雙向的。 我們進一步顯示在適度的時間引導下，計劃相關能力指標的改善。 這些結果表明，模型的跨期偏好是可測量和可引導的，這對於提供涉及延遲成本和收益的建議的 AI 系統，以及關於長期規劃的安全問題是相關的。
